items.title: Arsenal vs Man City LIVE! Your views ahead of Community Shield...
Djokovic reveals ongoing health condition after Cincinnati defeat
items.description: Novak Djokovic revealed he has been dealing with an ongoing health condition after his surprise second-round defeat at the Cincinnati Open.

items.title: Coventry agree deal for Forest striker Awoniyi
items.description: Coventry City agree a deal worth about £17m for Nottingham Forest striker Taiwo Awoniyi.

items.title: Villa agree deal to sign goalkeeper Suzuki as Juve make Martinez bid
items.description: Aston Villa have agreed a £29.9m (€35m) deal with Parma to sign Japan goalkeeper Zion Suzuki, according to Sky in Italy.

items.title: Maguire wants 'huge threat' Rashford to stay at Man Utd
items.description: Manchester United defender Harry Maguire says he hopes Marcus Rashford will stay at the club because he can improve Michael Carrick's team.

items.title: Wrexham's Premier League bid: Crazy or credible?
items.description: “We've come a long way in five years". A post from Ryan Reynolds back in May, reflecting on another touchstone of his Wrexham revolution: the club's best finish in their 162-year history. "We have so much to be proud of, Reds".

items.title: Newcastle agree deal to sign Dedic from Benfica
items.description: Newcastle United have reached an agreement with Benfica to sign defender Amar Dedic.

items.title: Athletics medal ceremonies postponed after police arrest
items.description: Medal ceremonies at the European Athletics Championships in Birmingham were postponed on Saturday evening and transport services suspended after a man was arrested on suspicion of fraud.

items.title: Wild celebrations sparked as St Helens keep their play-off hopes alive!
items.description: There were jubilant scenes at the full-time whistle as St Helens kept their play-off hopes alive with victory over Wakefield Trinity, with players and supporters celebrating together in the stands.

items.title: Shields stops Scott to reclaim WBC and WBA middleweight belts
items.description: Claressa Shields stopped Kaye Scott in the sixth round to reclaim the WBC and WBA middleweight belts in Atlanta.

items.title: Tennis scores: Fery wins in Cincinnati on first appearance since Wimbledon heroics
Bangladesh pull off historic Test upset against Australia
items.description: Bangladesh completed a stunning nine-wicket victory over Australia in the first Test on Sunday, securing their first win on Australian soil and just their second Test victory over the world’s top-ranked side.
